task_title: Crash paths on fresh projects and library API
task_criteria: speclang history in a fresh git repo with no commits prints no GitError stack trace; docs/API_REFERENCE.md documents that codegen target comes from getTarget()

items.criterion: speclang history in a fresh git repo with no commits prints no GitError stack trace; docs/API_REFERENCE.md documents that codegen target comes from getTarget()
items.detail: Neither half is delivered in the repository. (a) Crash path: bin/speclang has no empty-state guard — `grep -n 'detectEmptyHistory\|EMPTY_HISTORY' bin/speclang` returns 0 hits, and the history action (bin/speclang:2439-2624) calls `git.log(...)`/`git.diff(...)`/`git.raw(...)` directly. Reproduced: `mkdir /tmp/r5-fresh && cd /tmp/r5-fresh && git init -q . && node /home/kara/SpecLang/bin/speclang history` prints `GitError: fatal: your current branch 'master' does not have any commits yet` plus a full node stack trace (`at Object.action (.../simple-git/dist/cjs/index.js:1374:25)`), EXIT=1. Same for `history --stat` and `history --format json`. (b) Docs: docs/API_REFERENCE.md (symlink -> specs/docs.spec.dir/docs/API_REFERENCE.md, 148 lines) never states that the codegen target comes from getTarget(); the only occurrence is a bare export name in a list at line 41 (`- Targets: ... \`getTarget\`, \`getAllTargets\``), with no codegen()/targetId explanation. The claimed commit 4d110c6c7d2fef224156f2c1fbf09d2db0db373a does not exist in this repo (`git cat-file -t` -> 'could not get object info'), and `git diff HEAD -- bin/speclang tests/cli/history.test.ts specs/docs.spec.dir/docs/API_REFERENCE.md` is empty — the three files are unchanged (last touched by 2597ca95 / c2e39f2c / 48b4886b). Test run: `npx vitest run tests/cli/history.test.ts` -> 'Test Files 1 passed (1) / Tests 11 passed (11)', but that file is the pre-change version with no fresh-repo test.

items.criterion: The empty-state guard is reachable from the `speclang history` entrypoint (bin/speclang history action) for the default invocation, not only for --stat/--blame/--compare
items.detail: No guard exists anywhere in bin/speclang (grep for detectEmptyHistory/EMPTY_HISTORY/EMPTY_HISTORY_UNBORN = 0 hits). The history action at bin/speclang:2439-2624 goes straight to `const git = require('simple-git')()` then `git.diff`/`git.log`/`git.raw`. Reproduced in /tmp/r5-fresh (git init, no commits): default `history`, `history --stat` and `history --format json` all emit the GitError stack trace.

items.criterion: A regression test in tests/cli/history.test.ts exercises `speclang history` in a fresh `git init` repo with no commits and asserts no GitError/stack trace
items.detail: tests/cli/history.test.ts is unchanged (4630 bytes; `git log -1 -- tests/cli/history.test.ts` -> 48b4886b 'style: prettier format'); `grep -n 'unborn\|no commits\|detectEmptyHistory\|GitError' tests/cli/history.test.ts` returns 0 hits. `npx vitest run tests/cli/history.test.ts` -> 'Tests 11 passed (11)' — green while the crash path is unguarded, i.e. nothing pins the behaviour.

items.criterion: The documented getTarget()/codegen-target statement matches the shipped code (codegen(ir, targetId) resolves via getTarget)
items.detail: There is no such statement to match: specs/docs.spec.dir/docs/API_REFERENCE.md:41 lists `getTarget` only as an export name. The underlying code fact is real and undocumented — src/compiler/phases/codegen.ts:10-11 `export function codegen(ir: IR, targetId: string)` -> `const target = getTarget(targetId)` (throws `Unknown target: ${targetId}` when undefined), and src/compiler/targets/index.ts:121-123 `getTarget(lang)` lowercases the id before lookup.
